species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 60°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 36–40 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 60°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 14–26 ft deep, mostly on sheltered coves.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.
